data.title: Bài 106: The Checkout Process in E-commerce
data.transcript: Lisa bought a course on TuanQK Education shop. She explains the checkout process in English. First, you browse. You look at courses and read descriptions. Second, you add to cart. You click Add to Cart button. Third, you review cart. You see what you want to buy and the total price. Fourth, you checkout. You enter your name, email, and address. Fifth, you pay. You choose payment method: credit card, MoMo, or bank transfer. Sixth, you get confirmation. You see Thank you for your purchase and receive an email receipt. If any step is complicated, users will abandon the cart, which means they leave without paying. Tuan made checkout very simple: only two steps and guest checkout, which means you don't need to create an account. After checkout, users can access their course immediately. He added a listening lesson with phrases like Place order, Order summary, and Payment failed. He says, Good checkout is like a smooth road. No bumps, no confusion. Users should go from wanting to buying in less than one minute.

data.title: Bài 107: Learning HTML and CSS
data.transcript:
Tuan teaches HTML and CSS in a listening lesson. HTML is the skeleton. It uses tags like

for heading,

for paragraph, and for image. CSS is the clothing. It makes HTML beautiful. It controls color, size, and position. For example, HTML says, This is a button. CSS says, Make the button blue, round, and big. Tuan shows a simple example: becomes a blue button. He says you can learn HTML in one day and CSS in one week. They are not programming languages. They are markup and style languages. Many designers learn them to build simple websites. He added an exercise where students change the color of a button and see the result immediately. He says, When you change CSS and see your page become beautiful instantly, you feel powerful. HTML and CSS are the first steps to become a web developer. If you can build a simple page with your name and photo, you are already a developer.

data.title: Bài 108: The Importance of Backups
data.transcript: One day, TuanQK Education database crashed and lost one day of user progress. Users were angry because their 500/705 became 490/705. Tuan learned the importance of backups. A backup is a copy of your data stored in a different place. He now makes automatic backups every six hours. If something breaks, he can restore from backup. He explains 3-2-1 rule: Keep 3 copies of your data, on 2 different devices, with 1 copy offsite in the cloud. He uses Supabase automatic backups and also exports JSON files to Google Drive. He added a listening lesson with words like backup, restore, and disaster. He tells students, Backups are like insurance. You hope you never need them, but when you need them, they save your life. He also tells students to backup their English notes. Don't keep your notebook only in one place. Take photos and save in Google Drive. If you lose your phone, you still have your notes in the cloud.

data.title: Bài 109: How Notifications Work
data.transcript: When you complete a lesson, TuanQK Education shows a notification: Congratulations! You completed Lesson 26. How does it work? Tuan explains. There are two types of notifications: local and push. Local notification is scheduled by the app itself. For example, daily reminder at 8 PM: Time to learn English. Push notification comes from the server. For example, when Tuan publishes a new lesson, the server pushes to all users: New lesson available. To send push, the app uses Firebase Cloud Messaging. The app asks user, Can we send you notifications? If user says yes, Firebase gives a token, which is like an address. When Tuan wants to notify, he sends message to that token. He warns not to send too many notifications, or users will turn them off. One per day is enough. He added a listening lesson with words like notification, permission, and reminder. He says, Good notifications are helpful. Bad notifications are annoying. A good notification is like a kind friend reminding you. A bad notification is like a noisy neighbor.

data.title: Bài 110: Introduction to JavaScript
data.transcript: JavaScript is the most popular programming language for websites. Tuan explains it simply. If HTML is bones and CSS is clothes, JavaScript is the brain. It makes websites interactive. When you click GHI AM and it starts recording, that is JavaScript. When you type in search box and results appear instantly, that is JavaScript. JavaScript runs in your browser, not on the server, so it is very fast. Tuan shows a simple example: let name = Lisa; alert('Hello ' + name); It shows a popup saying Hello Lisa. He says JavaScript is easy to start but hard to master. You can learn basics in one week and build a simple game. He built a small game for TuanQK Education where you match English words with pictures using JavaScript. Students love it. He added a listening lesson with words like function, variable, and event. He tells students, If you want to build interactive websites, learn JavaScript. It is the language of the web. Every website you love uses JavaScript to make you smile.

data.title: Bài 111: The Design Thinking Process
data.transcript: Lisa learned design thinking to improve TuanQK Education app. Design thinking has five steps. First, Empathize. Talk to users and understand their problems. She interviewed ten students and found they are busy and have only ten minutes a day. Second, Define. Write the problem clearly: Students need to learn English in ten minutes with one hand on the bus. Third, Ideate. Brainstorm many ideas: short videos, audio lessons, flashcards. Fourth, Prototype. Build a simple version quickly with paper or simple code. Fifth, Test. Give prototype to users and watch them use it. Lisa did these five steps and created the 3-step lesson: Nghe, Noi lai, Viet lai, which fits in ten minutes. She added a listening lesson with words like empathize, prototype, and feedback. She says, Design thinking is not just for designers. It is for anyone who wants to solve problems. You don't need to be a genius. You just need to listen to users, try small ideas, and improve quickly. That is how good products are built.

data.title: Bài 112: Understanding File Formats
data.transcript: TuanQK Education uses many file formats. Tuan explains them in a listening lesson. MP4 is for video. It is small and works everywhere. That is why lessons use MP4 from Cloudinary. MP3 is for audio. It is small and good for music. JSON is for data. It is text that both humans and computers can read. Like {"id": "nh_26", "title": "Market"}. PNG is for images with transparent background, good for logos. JPG is for photos, small but no transparency. PDF is for documents that must look same everywhere. When you export your progress, you get PDF. He says each format has a purpose. Don't use JPG for logo because it will have white background. Don't use PNG for long video because it will be huge. He added an exercise where students match format to use: Which format for video? MP4. Which for data? JSON. Understanding file formats helps you choose the right tool for the right job and saves storage and time.

data.title: Bài 113: The E-commerce Customer Journey
data.transcript: Lisa studies e-commerce customer journey. It is the path a customer takes from knowing to buying. First, Awareness. Customer sees TuanQK ad on Facebook: Learn English in 10 minutes a day. Second, Interest. Customer clicks and visits website, reads about 705 lessons. Third, Consideration. Customer compares with other apps, reads reviews, watches demo video. Fourth, Purchase. Customer buys a course for 199,000 dong. Fifth, Retention. Customer uses the app every day and gets value. Sixth, Advocacy. Customer loves the app and tells friends: You should try TuanQK. Lisa says many businesses only focus on purchase, but retention and advocacy are more important. It costs five times more to get a new customer than to keep an old one. TuanQK focuses on retention by sending daily reminders and making lessons fun. He added a listening lesson with words like awareness, conversion, and loyalty. He says, Good e-commerce is not about selling once. It is about building a relationship so customers stay and bring friends.

data.title: Bài 114: What is an App Framework
data.transcript: TuanQK Education is built with a framework. What is a framework? Tuan explains with building a house. Without framework, you must make bricks, cement, and wood yourself. With framework, you get ready-made walls, windows, and doors. You just assemble them. In programming, a framework gives you ready-made functions for common tasks like login, database, and notifications. Tuan uses Flutter for mobile app and Next.js for website. Flutter is a framework by Google that lets you build one app for both Android and iPhone with one code. Next.js is a framework for websites that makes them fast. He says frameworks save time. Without framework, building TuanQK would take three years. With framework, it took one year. But you must learn the framework's rules. He added a listening lesson with words like framework, library, and component. He tells students, Don't build everything from zero. Use frameworks to stand on the shoulders of giants. That is how small teams can build big products like TuanQK Education.

data.title: Bài 115: The Future of E-learning
data.transcript: Tuan imagines the future of e-learning in 2030. He says learning will be personal, not one-size-fits-all. AI will know your level and recommend perfect lessons. If you are weak in pronunciation, it will give you more speaking practice. If you are busy, it will give you 3-minute lessons. Virtual reality will let you practice English in a virtual cafe in London without leaving Vietnam. You can order coffee with a virtual waiter. Blockchain will give you certificates that no one can fake. When you complete 150 listening lessons, you get a certificate that employers can verify. TuanQK Education is preparing for this future. He is adding AI feedback, short lessons, and blockchain certificates. He added a listening lesson with words like personalized, virtual reality, and future. He says, The future of e-learning is not about more content. It is about the right content at the right time for the right person. Technology will change, but the goal stays the same: help students speak English with confidence and change their lives.

data.title: Bài 116: Tuan Pham and His First Android Car Screen
data.transcript: Tuan Pham loves cars and technology. One day, a customer brought a Nissan Sunny with an old radio. The radio could only play FM and CDs. Tuan Pham said, We can change this old radio into a smart Android screen. He removed the old radio carefully with special tools. He installed a 9-inch Android screen with Android 13. The screen has WiFi, GPS, and Bluetooth. When he turned on the car, the screen showed a beautiful interface with maps and music. The customer was amazed. He said, My old Nissan now looks like a new car. Tuan Pham explained how to use voice control: Say Hey TuanQK, navigate home, and the map opens. He also showed how to connect Bluetooth to play music from phone. The customer drove away happily, listening to English audiobooks on his new screen. Tuan Pham realized that an Android screen does not just make a car more beautiful. It makes driving safer and more fun. That first installation was the start of his car tech journey.

data.title: Bài 117: How a Car Engine Works
data.transcript: In a listening lesson for drivers, Tuan Pham explains how a car engine works in simple English. He says, An engine is like a heart. It pumps power to the wheels. Most cars like Honda City and Mazda 3 use a four-stroke engine. First stroke is intake. The engine breathes in air and fuel. Second stroke is compression. It squeezes the air and fuel tightly. Third stroke is power. A spark plug makes a small explosion that pushes the piston down. Fourth stroke is exhaust. The smoke goes out through the exhaust pipe. This happens thousands of times per minute. That is why you hear vroom vroom. The engine needs oil to be smooth and coolant to not get too hot. Tuan Pham tells drivers, Check your oil every month. If oil is black and dirty, change it. If you take care of your engine, it will take care of you for 300,000 kilometers. Understanding your engine helps you drive better and save money on repairs.

data.title: Bài 118: Installing Sensors for Safe Parking
data.transcript: A customer with a Honda CR-V was afraid of parking. The car is big and she could not see behind. Tuan Pham installed four parking sensors on the rear bumper. He explains, Sensors are like eyes. They use ultrasonic waves to measure distance. When you get close to a wall, the sensor beeps. Beep beep faster means closer. He drilled four small holes in the bumper and connected the sensors to the Android screen. When the driver puts the car in reverse, the screen shows distance in centimeters and colors: green is safe, yellow is careful, red is stop. He also installed a rear camera. Now when she reverses, she can see everything on the 9-inch screen with guide lines. The customer practiced parking three times and said, Now I can park without fear. Tuan Pham added a listening lesson with words like sensor, bumper, and reverse. He says, Technology does not replace skill, but it helps you be safe. Parking sensors are cheap but can prevent expensive accidents.

data.title: Bài 119: The Magic of Voice Control on the Road
data.transcript: Tuan Pham demonstrates voice control on a Mazda CX-5 with Android screen. He says, Imagine you are driving at 80 kilometers per hour. You should not touch the screen. You should keep your eyes on the road. Voice control helps you stay safe. He presses the voice button on the steering wheel and says, Play English listening lesson 26. The screen opens TuanQK Education audio. He says, Navigate to TuanQK Tower. Google Maps opens and shows the route. He says, Call Mom. The phone calls his mom through Bluetooth. The system uses Google Assistant and understands both English and Vietnamese. Tuan Pham teaches customers useful voice commands: Open maps, Play music, Increase volume, and Go home. He says, Voice control is not magic. It is speech recognition. The Android screen converts your voice to text, then does the action. He adds a listening lesson with phrases like Hands-free, Voice command, and Stay focused. He tells drivers, Your voice is the safest remote control when you drive.

data.title: Bài 120: Bluetooth and Hands-Free Calling
data.transcript: Many drivers hold their phone while driving. It is very dangerous. Tuan Pham teaches about Bluetooth hands-free. He installed an Android screen in a Nissan Navara. He paired the driver's phone with the car via Bluetooth. He explains, Bluetooth is like invisible wire. It connects phone and car without cable within 10 meters. Once paired, when someone calls, the car speakers ring and the screen shows the caller name. You press Answer on the steering wheel and talk. Your voice goes through a small microphone near the mirror. The other person hears you clearly. When you finish, you press Hang up. Your hands never leave the steering wheel. Tuan Pham also shows how to play music via Bluetooth. Open Spotify on phone, and music plays in car speakers. He adds a listening lesson with words like pair, connect, and hands-free. He says, In many countries, holding phone while driving is illegal. Bluetooth keeps you legal and safe. One tap to pair, and you can drive safely for years.

data.title: Bài 121: Dashcam - Your Silent Witness
data.transcript: Tuan Pham always recommends a dashcam, or camera hanh trinh. He tells a story. A customer with a Honda Civic had an accident. Another car hit him and said it was his fault. But his dashcam recorded everything. The video showed the other car ran a red light. The police watched the video and said the other driver was wrong. The dashcam saved him money and trouble. Tuan Pham installs 4K dashcams that record front and rear. The dashcam connects to the Android screen and records automatically when the car starts. It has G-sensor. If there is a collision, it locks the video so it cannot be deleted. It also has parking mode. If someone hits your car when you are away, it records. The video is saved on a memory card. Tuan Pham teaches how to view videos on the Android screen. He adds a listening lesson with words like evidence, record, and witness. He says, A dashcam is like a silent passenger who never sleeps. It does not prevent accidents, but it tells the truth when you need it.

data.title: Bài 122: Navigation and Offline Maps
data.transcript: A customer with a Mazda 2 said, I get lost when I drive to new places and my 4G is weak. Tuan Pham installed offline maps on his Android screen with his own product. He explains, Online maps like Google Maps need internet. Offline maps work without internet. You download the map of Vietnam once when you have WiFi, about 2 gigabytes. Then you can navigate without 4G. The GPS chip in the Android screen talks to satellites in space to find your location. It shows your car on the map and gives voice directions: In 300 meters, turn left. Tuan Pham shows how to use TuanQK Navigation and TuanQKCam, which have better data for Vietnam, including speed limits and police camera warnings. TuanQK Navigation is for smart routing, and TuanQKCam is for dashcam and safety alerts. He adds a listening lesson with phrases like Turn left, Go straight, and You have arrived. He says, With TuanQK Navigation and TuanQKCam, you will never be lost, even in the mountains where there is no phone signal. Navigation is not just about going fast. It is about going with confidence.

data.title: Bài 123: Entertainment System for Long Drives
data.transcript: Tuan Pham's customer drives a Nissan X-Trail from Hanoi to Shizuoka, Japan, 350 kilometers, every month. The drive is long and boring. Tuan Pham turned his car into an entertainment system. He installed an Android screen with YouTube, Netflix, and TuanQK Education. But he sets a safety rule: Video only plays when the car is parked. When driving, only audio plays. He shows how to use split screen: left side is Google Maps, right side is music. He connects a 4G SIM directly to the Android screen, so the car has its own WiFi hotspot. Passengers can connect their phones. He also installs headrest monitors for kids in the back seat. They can watch cartoons while parents listen to audiobooks in front. He adds a listening lesson with words like entertainment, streaming, and hotspot. He says, A long drive should not be boring. With the right system, a 5-hour drive becomes 5 hours of learning English with TuanQK listening lessons. Your car becomes a moving classroom.

data.title: Bài 124: Listening to Audiobooks While Driving
data.transcript: Tuan Pham loves audiobooks. He says, Driving time is learning time. He installed TuanQK Education listening lessons on a Honda HR-V Android screen. He shows how to listen safely. First, open the listening app on the Android screen. Second, choose a lesson, for example Bài 26 Morning Market. Third, press play and keep eyes on road. The audio plays through car speakers. The screen shows the transcript in large text so you can glance quickly at red lights. He teaches a method: Listen once without reading, listen again and repeat one sentence, then try to retell the story at home. He says, Don't try to write while driving. Just listen and speak. Many customers love this. A customer who drives Grab every day learned 150 listening lessons in 3 months just by listening in his car. Tuan Pham adds a listening lesson with phrases like Eyes on the road, Hands on the wheel, and Learn while you drive. Your car is not just transport. It is your private English classroom.

data.title: Bài 57: Nuốt âm /h/ và rút gọn (Contractions and Weak Forms)
data.transcript:
1. Quy tắc: Trong nói nhanh, /h/ ở đầu đại từ (he, him, his, her) thường bị nuốt. Các dạng rút gọn phổ biến.
2. Ví dụ:
- Tell_him /tel_ɪm/ → /telɪm/ (bảo anh ấy)
- Ask_her /ɑːsk_ər/ → /ɑːskər/ (hỏi cô ấy)
- I have /aɪv/, You have /jʊv/, He is /hiːz/ → /ɪz/ trong câu nhanh
- Going to /ɡənə/ (gonna), Want to /wɒnə/ (wanna), Have to /hæftə/ (hafta)
- Do you /dʒə/ → /dʒə/ trong Do you want? /dʒəwɒnə/?
3. Câu thực hành: Tell him I wanna gonna have to ask her.
4. Lưu ý: Weak forms: to /tə/, for /fər/, and /ən/, of /əv/.

data.title: Bài 125: Nissan Almera Android Upgrade
data.transcript: A young driver brought a Nissan Almera 2022 to Tuan Pham's shop. The original screen was small and slow. It had no TuanQK Navigation and no YouTube. Tuan Pham recommended an Android screen with 4GB RAM and 64GB storage, with QLED display. He explains why Nissan needs special canbus. Canbus is a translator between car and new screen. Without canbus, steering wheel buttons and air conditioning display will not work. Tuan Pham installed the correct canbus for Nissan. After installation, the steering wheel volume buttons worked, and the AC information showed on the Android screen. The customer tested: voice control, Bluetooth, and dashcam all worked. He said, My Almera now feels like a premium car. Tuan Pham adds a listening lesson with words like canbus, compatible, and upgrade. He says, Each car brand is different. Nissan, Mazda, and Honda have different wires. A good installer must know each car. Installing Android screen is not just putting a tablet in a car. It is integrating technology so the car and screen become one.

data.title: Bài 67: So & Such ... that - Quá ... đến nỗi
data.theory:
1. So + adj/adv + that + S+V = quá... đến nỗi mà: It was so hot that we stayed inside (Trời nóng quá đến nỗi chúng tôi ở trong nhà)
2. Such + (a/an) + adj + N + that + S+V = quá... đến nỗi: It was such a hot day that... (Đó là một ngày nóng quá đến nỗi...)
3. So much/many/little/few + N + that: There was so much traffic that we were late.
4. Phân biệt So vs Such: So + adj/adv, Such + N (có adj). So beautiful vs Such a beautiful girl.
5. Dùng trong IELTS Writing để nhấn mạnh kết quả.
data.examples:
1. The movie was so boring that I fell asleep after 20 minutes.
   (Phim chán quá đến nỗi tôi ngủ gật sau 20 phút.)
2. It was such a beautiful sunset that everyone stopped to take photos.
   (Hoàng hôn đẹp quá đến nỗi mọi người đều dừng lại chụp ảnh.)
3. There were so many people at the concert that we couldn't find a place to sit.
   (Có quá nhiều người ở buổi hòa nhạc đến nỗi chúng tôi không tìm được chỗ ngồi.)
4. He speaks so quickly that nobody can understand him.
   (Anh ấy nói nhanh quá đến nỗi không ai hiểu được.)
5. She is such a kind person that everyone loves her.
   (Cô ấy là người tốt bụng đến nỗi ai cũng yêu quý.)

data.title: Bài 126: Mazda 3 and the 360 Camera System
data.transcript: A Mazda 3 owner was scared of narrow streets in Hanoi. Tuan Pham installed a 360 camera system with 4 cameras: front, rear, left, right. The Android screen stitches the 4 videos into a bird-eye view, like you are looking from above. When you turn left, the left camera shows automatically. When you put in reverse, the rear camera with trajectory lines shows. Tuan Pham calibrated the cameras so the lines are accurate. He shows the customer how to use 3D view to see around the car. The customer said, Now I can see all four sides without opening the door. It is very safe for my kids. Tuan Pham explains that 360 system needs a powerful Android screen with at least 4GB RAM to process 4 videos at once. He adds a listening lesson with words like bird-eye, calibration, and blind spot. He says, Blind spots cause many accidents. 360 cameras remove blind spots. Technology helps you see what your eyes cannot. For a family car like Mazda 3, safety is the most important upgrade.

data.title: Bài 127: Honda City and Fuel Efficiency Display
data.transcript: Honda City is famous for saving fuel. Tuan Pham shows how Android screen can help save even more fuel. He installed an OBD2 device that connects to the car's computer. OBD2 reads data like fuel consumption, engine temperature, and RPM. The Android screen shows this data in real time. When you drive smoothly at 60 kilometers per hour, it shows 5.2 liters per 100 kilometers. When you accelerate hard, it shows 9.8 liters. The driver learns to drive more gently. Tuan Pham also shows tire pressure monitoring, or TPMS, on the Android screen. If tire pressure is low, it warns: Tire pressure low, please check. Low pressure wastes fuel and is dangerous. A Honda City customer saved 15 percent fuel after one month using this display. Tuan Pham adds a listening lesson with words like fuel efficiency, OBD2, and tire pressure. He says, An Android screen is not just for entertainment. It is a dashboard that helps you understand your car and drive smarter and cheaper.

data.title: Bài 128: The Future of Smart Cars
data.transcript: Tuan Pham imagines the future of smart cars. He says, In 2030, your car will be like your smartphone on wheels. You will say, Hey car, take me to work using the fastest route without traffic. The car will drive itself a little bit with ADAS, advanced driver assistance. ADAS includes lane keeping, which keeps your car in lane, and adaptive cruise control, which keeps distance from the car in front. Android screens today are preparing for that future. They already have ADAS warnings. If you go too close to another car, it beeps. If you leave your lane without signaling, it warns. Tuan Pham installs ADAS cameras on Nissan and Honda cars. He shows how the camera sees lane lines and cars. He adds a listening lesson with words like autonomous, assistance, and future. He says, We are not yet in self-driving cars, but we are in assisted driving. The Android screen is the brain that connects camera, sensor, and driver. The future is not far. It is already on your dashboard.

data.title: Bài 129: Installing Subwoofer and Sound System
data.transcript: A young customer with a Mazda 6 loves music. The original speakers were weak. Tuan Pham upgraded the sound system. He installed a DSP, digital sound processor, which makes sound clear and balanced. He installed a subwoofer in the trunk for deep bass. He explains, Music has three parts: high, middle, and low. Small speakers can play high and middle, but need subwoofer for low bass. After upgrade, when the customer played Beautiful in White, which is also in TuanQK listening lessons, the sound was rich and warm. He could hear every instrument. Tuan Pham tuned the sound using an app on the Android screen. He adjusted equalizer for vocal, for EDM, and for audiobook. For audiobook, he boosts middle frequencies so voice is clear. He adds a listening lesson with words like bass, treble, and equalizer. He says, Good sound is not just loud. It is clear. When you listen to English listening lessons with good sound, you hear pronunciation details that cheap speakers hide. Sound quality helps you learn better.

data.title: Bài 51: Trọng âm câu - Nhấn để nhấn mạnh ý
data.transcript:
1. Quy tắc: Có thể thay đổi trọng âm câu để nhấn mạnh thông tin mới hoặc đối lập.
2. Ví dụ:
- I love YOUR tea (không phải tea của người khác)
- I LOVE your tea (tôi thực sự yêu)
- I love your TEA (không phải coffee của bạn)
3. Câu thực hành: I DIDN'T say HE stole MY MONEY. (Mỗi lần nhấn từ khác, nghĩa khác nhau)
4. Lưu ý: Trọng âm câu thay đổi nghĩa, dùng để sửa sai hoặc nhấn mạnh.

data.title: Bài 130: Car Maintenance Through the Screen
data.transcript: Tuan Pham added a maintenance reminder on the Android screen. He explains, Many drivers forget to change oil or check brakes. The Android screen can remind you. You set, Change oil every 5,000 kilometers. When you reach 5,000, the screen shows, Time to change oil. You set, Check brakes every 20,000 kilometers. It reminds you. For a Honda CR-V, he set reminders for oil, air filter, and coolant. The customer said, This is like a personal assistant for my car. Tuan Pham also shows how to check battery voltage on the screen. If voltage is below 12 volts, battery is weak and you should replace. He adds a listening lesson with words like maintenance, reminder, and schedule. He says, A car is like your body. It needs regular checkups. An Android screen with maintenance reminders helps you take care of your car on time. That saves money and keeps you safe on long trips from Shizuoka to Hanoi.

data.title: Bài 131: Connecting Multiple Cameras
data.transcript: A Nissan Terra owner who travels to construction sites wanted many cameras. Tuan Pham installed a system with 6 cameras: front, rear, left, right, and two for blind spots under mirrors. All cameras connect to the Android screen. He explains how to switch views. You can see front camera when climbing a hill to see the road ahead. You can see rear camera when reversing with a trailer. You can record all cameras at once on a 128GB memory card. If something happens, you have video from 6 angles. He shows how to use the Android screen to adjust brightness and night vision. At night, cameras use infrared to see in dark. The customer said, Now I can drive my Terra off-road with confidence. Tuan Pham adds a listening lesson with words like multiple, angle, and night vision. He says, For SUV drivers who go off-road, cameras are more important than entertainment. They are your eyes when the road is rough and dangerous. More cameras mean more safety and more peace of mind.

data.title: Bài 132: The Language of the Road
data.transcript: Tuan Pham teaches his customers English for driving. He says, When you drive with a foreign friend, you need road English. He teaches phrases: Buckle up means wear seatbelt. Keep a safe distance means don't drive too close. Speed limit means maximum speed allowed. No entry means you cannot go in. He installed an Android screen that shows speed limit from TuanQK Navigation. When you go over speed limit, it says in English, You are over speed limit. Slow down. He also teaches car parts in English: steering wheel, brake, accelerator, rearview mirror. A customer from Mazda club practiced: My steering wheel has volume control. My rearview mirror has dashcam. Tuan Pham adds a listening lesson called Road English. He says, If you know road English, you can drive in any country. You can rent a car in America and understand GPS. You can read traffic signs in English. Learning English through your car is practical because you use it every day. Your car is your English teacher on wheels.

data.title: Bài 133: Building a Car Entertainment Business
data.transcript: Tuan Pham started his car Android screen shop with only one table and a toolbox. He learned everything from YouTube in English. He watched videos like How to install Android screen on Honda City. He did not understand everything at first, but he tried. His first installation took 6 hours. Now he can do it in 90 minutes. He built a small team. He teaches them, Be careful with car wires. One wrong wire can cause airbag error. Always disconnect battery first. He also teaches customer service in English. When a foreign customer comes with a Nissan, he says, Hello, how can I help you with your car? He learned e-commerce to sell screens online. Customers from Shizuoka, Japan, Nghe An, and Hanoi order from his website. He ships and installs via video call. He adds a listening lesson about starting a small business with words like installation, customer service, and warranty. He says, You don't need a big shop to start. You need skill, honesty, and a willingness to learn from English videos. That is how Tuan Pham turned his passion for cars into a business.

data.title: Bài 134: The Smart Driving Assistant
data.transcript: Tuan Pham installed a smart driving assistant on a Honda Accord. The assistant is an AI that talks to you. It says, Good morning, Tuan. Traffic to TuanQK Tower is heavy, 45 minutes. Do you want a faster route? It reminds you, Your fuel is low. There is a gas station 1 kilometer ahead. It warns, You have been driving for 2 hours. Please take a break. The assistant connects to the Android screen and uses internet to get traffic data. It also connects to your calendar. If you have a meeting at 9 AM, it says, You have a meeting in 30 minutes. You should leave now. Tuan Pham says this assistant is like a co-pilot. It does not drive for you, but it gives you information so you make better decisions. He adds a listening lesson with words like assistant, traffic, and remind. He says, Smart driving is not about fast driving. It is about informed driving. When your car talks to you and gives you useful information, you drive safer and less stressed. That is the future Tuan Pham is building, one Android screen at a time.

data.title: Bài 60: Ngữ điệu lên-xuống và xuống-lên (Fall-Rise and Rise-Fall)
data.transcript:
1. Quy tắc: Fall-Rise (xuống rồi lên) thể hiện ngập ngừng, chưa chắc chắn, lịch sự, đối lập. Rise-Fall (lên rồi xuống) thể hiện nhấn mạnh, nhiệt tình, chắc chắn.
2. Ví dụ:
- I think it's ↘good↗... but... (Fall-Rise: ngập ngừng, chưa chắc tốt lắm)
- I ↘LOVE↗ it? No, I like it. (Fall-Rise: đối lập)
- You are ↗WELCOME↘! (Rise-Fall: nhiệt tình, chào mừng)
- That's ↗WONDERFUL↘! (Tuyệt vời! nhiệt tình)
- Are you sure? Well, I think ↘so↗... (không chắc)
3. Câu thực hành: I think your tea is wonderful, but maybe a little strong... You are welcome! That's wonderful!
4. Lưu ý: Ngữ điệu quyết định thái độ, quan trọng hơn cả từ vựng. Luyện tập với video mẫu.

data.title: Bài 135: My Car, My Second Home
data.transcript: For many Vietnamese people, the car is a second home. Tuan Pham met a customer who drives 3 hours every day for work. The customer said, I spend more time in my car than in my living room. So I want my car to be comfortable. Tuan Pham made his Honda City comfortable like home. He installed ambient light that changes color: blue for calm, orange for warm. He installed a good air freshener that smells like coffee. He put a small tissue box and phone holder in a good position. Most importantly, he set up audiobooks and English listening lessons to play automatically when the car starts. The customer said, Now my car is my happy place. I learn English, listen to music, and relax. No more road rage. Tuan Pham adds a final listening lesson for this batch with words like comfortable, ambient, and second home. He says, Your car should not be a place of stress. With the right Android screen, good sound, clean air, and good content like TuanQK listening lessons, your car becomes a place where you grow. My car, my second home, my moving classroom.

data.title: Bài 136: What is TuanQK AI
data.transcript: Tuan Pham always dreamed of an AI that understands Vietnamese students. He built TuanQK AI. What is TuanQK AI? Tuan explains in simple English. TuanQK AI is not a robot. It is a friendly assistant inside TuanQK Education app. It listens to your pronunciation and says, Good job, or Try again, a little slower. It remembers your mistakes and gives you easier lessons. If you forget the word apple, it shows you a picture of an apple tomorrow. TuanQK AI learns from you, and you learn from it. It is trained on thousands of listening lessons, from Bài 26 Morning Market to Bài 122 TuanQK Navigation. It knows Vietnamese culture, so it can explain banh chung in English. Tuan says, AI means Artificial Intelligence, but for us, AI means Always Inspiring. TuanQK AI does not replace teachers. It helps teachers have more time to care for students. It is technology with a warm heart.

data.title: Bài 137: TuanQK AI in the Rice Field
data.transcript: Tuan Pham took TuanQK AI to his grandmother's rice field. How can AI help a farmer? TuanQK AI uses a phone camera to look at rice leaves. It says in Vietnamese and English, This leaf has brown spot disease. You should use less water. The farmer does not need to read English. TuanQK AI speaks in Vietnamese: La lua bi dom nau. It also predicts weather. It says, Tomorrow will rain at 3 PM, so harvest today. TuanQK AI connects to a small weather sensor in the field that measures temperature and humidity. Tuan explains, Technology should not destroy nature. It should help nature live harmoniously. AI helps farmers use less pesticide and less water, so the soil stays healthy and the river stays clean. His grandmother does not understand AI, but she understands when TuanQK AI says, The rice is happy today. She laughs. TuanQK AI brings modern technology to traditional life without breaking harmony.

data.title: Bài 138: TuanQK AI Helps Children Learn
data.transcript: In a small primary school in Shizuoka, Japan, Tuan Pham installed TuanQK AI on old tablets. The children have no English teacher. TuanQK AI becomes their teacher. It shows a picture of a cat and says, Cat. The children repeat, Cat. AI listens and says, Excellent. Your pronunciation is 90 percent correct. If a child is shy, AI does not get angry. It says, Let's try again together. It plays games. It says, Find something blue in the classroom. Children run and find a blue book. It teaches English through nature: Look at the tree outside. How many leaves? Count in English: One, two, three. Tuan Pham watches the children laugh and learn. He says, AI should not make children stare at screens all day. It should make them look at the world and describe it in English. TuanQK AI brings English to remote areas where teachers cannot go. It is small, cheap, and kind. That is the harmony Tuan dreams of: technology helping every child, not just rich children in cities.

data.title: Bài 139: TuanQK AI and the Smart Garden
data.transcript: Behind TuanQK Tower, Uncle Hai has a small garden. Tuan Pham added TuanQK AI to the garden. Small sensors in the soil measure water. When soil is dry, TuanQK AI sends a message to Uncle Hai's phone: Your tomatoes are thirsty. Please water them. It also uses a camera to watch sunflowers. It says, Sunflowers are blooming. They need more sunlight. Move the pot to the right. Uncle Hai does not know English, but TuanQK AI translates to Vietnamese and speaks slowly. It also teaches English while gardening. When Uncle Hai waters, AI says, Water. You are watering. Repeat: watering. Uncle Hai laughs and repeats. He learns English without studying. Tuan Pham says, This is harmonious technology. AI does not replace the gardener. It helps the gardener be a better gardener and learn English at the same time. The garden grows better, and Uncle Hai learns five new words a day. Nature and technology grow together. That is TuanQK AI's philosophy: help people live closer to nature, not farther.

data.title: Bài 140: TuanQK AI Listens to the Rain
data.transcript: Tuan Pham taught TuanQK AI to listen to nature. He recorded the sound of rain on the tin roof in his grandmother's house. He taught AI to recognize rain sounds: drizzle, downpour, and pitter-patter. When it rains, TuanQK AI plays a listening lesson: Listen, it is drizzling. Drizzle means light rain. Then it asks, How do you feel when it rains? It teaches emotional English through nature sounds. It also helps with mental health. If a user is stressed, TuanQK AI says, Let's listen to rain for one minute and breathe. Inhale, exhale. It plays real rain sound from Shizuoka. Users feel calm. Tuan Pham says, Many AI apps make people more anxious with fast notifications. TuanQK AI makes people calmer by connecting them to nature. It reminds you to look at the sky, listen to birds, and drink water. Technology should help you breathe, not make you hold your breath. TuanQK AI is an AI that teaches you to be human and be in harmony with nature.

data.title: Bài 141: TuanQK AI and the Bees
data.transcript: Near the TuanQK office, Tuan Pham keeps a small beehive. Bees are important for nature. TuanQK AI monitors the bees with a small camera and temperature sensor. It counts how many bees go out and come in. If many bees do not come back, AI warns: Bees are in danger. Maybe too much pesticide nearby. It tells farmers in simple English and Vietnamese: Please don't spray pesticide today, bees are working. It also teaches children about bees in English. It says, Bee makes honey. Honey is sweet. Bees help flowers grow. Children learn English and learn to love nature at the same time. Tuan Pham says, If AI can help us understand bees, it can help us understand we are part of nature, not above it. TuanQK AI does not just teach English. It teaches respect for small lives. A student asked, Why does an English app teach about bees? Tuan answered, Because if you learn English but forget to protect nature, your English has no meaning. Harmonious life means learning and protecting together.

data.title: Bài 142: TuanQK AI in the Kitchen
data.transcript: Lisa uses TuanQK AI in her kitchen to cook healthily and learn English. She says, TuanQK AI, I have tomatoes, eggs, and rice. What can I cook? AI answers in English and Vietnamese: You can make tomato egg fried rice. First, wash tomatoes. Second, beat eggs. It shows video steps on the Android screen in the kitchen. It also calculates nutrition. It says, This dish has protein and vitamin C. Good for your health. If she wants to eat less oil, AI suggests steaming instead of frying. It speaks in clear, slow English so she can repeat: Steam means cook with hot water vapor. It also reminds her not to waste food. It says, You have leftover rice from yesterday. Use it today. Don't throw away. Lisa says TuanQK AI makes her kitchen more harmonious. She cooks healthier, wastes less, and learns English while cooking. Technology in the kitchen should not make you order more fast food. It should help you cook simple, natural food with love. That is TuanQK AI's kitchen philosophy.

data.title: Bài 143: TuanQK AI and Clean Water
data.transcript: In Shizuoka, some wells have dirty water. Tuan Pham built a small device with TuanQK AI that tests water quality. You put a drop of water in the device, and AI says, Water is clean and safe to drink, or Water has too much iron, please filter. It speaks in Vietnamese and English. It teaches children: Clean water is important. We must protect rivers. Don't throw trash in the river. Tuan Pham installed these devices in schools. Children learn English words like filter, clean, and protect while learning to protect their environment. TuanQK AI also reminds families to save water. It says, You used 100 liters today, 20 percent more than yesterday. Try to use less. Tuan says, AI should not only help people learn English for jobs abroad. It should help people live better where they are. Harmonious technology means using AI to keep water clean, air fresh, and community healthy. That is more important than any exam score. Clean water is the first lesson of harmonious life.

data.title: Bài 144: TuanQK AI Teaches Meditation
data.transcript: Many students are stressed before English exams. Tuan Pham added meditation to TuanQK AI. Every evening at 9 PM, AI says, Time to breathe. Let's meditate for 2 minutes. It plays soft nature sounds: birds in the morning market, rain on the roof, wind in the rice field. All sounds recorded in Shizuoka, Japan. AI guides in slow English: Close your eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. You are safe. You are learning. You are enough. Users say they sleep better after meditation. Tuan Pham says, Learning English should not make you anxious. It should make you peaceful. TuanQK AI does not push you to study more. Sometimes it says, You studied enough today. Go for a walk and look at trees. It knows when you are tired from your voice. If your voice sounds tired, it says, Let's take a break. Technology that only pushes makes people burn out. Harmonious technology knows when to say stop. TuanQK AI is like a kind teacher who cares about your health, not just your score.

data.title: Bài 145: TuanQK AI and the Old Tree
data.transcript: There is a 100-year-old banyan tree near Tuan Pham's house in Shizuoka. People love the tree because it gives shade. Tuan Pham put a small sign with a QR code on the tree. When you scan with TuanQK Education app, TuanQK AI tells the story of the tree in English and Vietnamese. It says, Hello, I am the banyan tree. I am 100 years old. I have seen many children grow up. Please protect me. Children scan and listen and learn English words like roots, branches, and shade. They also learn to love the tree. TuanQK AI monitors the tree health with sensors. If someone tries to cut a branch, AI sends alert to the village. Tuan says, AI can help us remember that old trees are teachers. They teach patience. They grow slowly but live long. TuanQK AI connects old nature and new technology. It makes technology feel warm and rooted, not cold and fast. Harmonious life means we use AI to protect old trees, not to build more concrete. The old banyan tree now has many young friends who visit and learn English under its shade.

data.title: Bài 146: TuanQK AI for the Blind
data.transcript: Tuan Pham met a blind student who wanted to learn English but could not see the screen. TuanQK AI helped him. It has voice mode. The student says, TuanQK AI, teach me today's lesson. AI speaks the whole lesson slowly and clearly. It asks, Repeat after me: The morning market is busy. The student repeats, and AI checks pronunciation by listening. It says, Good, 95 percent correct. It also describes pictures with words for blind students. It says, There is a picture of a river market with boats full of mangoes. The student can imagine. Tuan Pham says, Technology is truly harmonious when it helps everyone, not just people who can see. TuanQK AI is designed to be inclusive. It works with screen readers and voice control. It does not need you to tap. You can talk to it. This blind student now can speak basic English and works as a massage therapist for foreign tourists. He says, TuanQK AI gave me confidence. Tuan says, If AI can give confidence to one person who cannot see, it has done its job. Harmonious AI leaves no one behind.

data.title: Bài 147: TuanQK AI and Zero Waste
data.transcript: TuanQK AI teaches zero waste in English. Zero waste means try not to create trash. In the office, AI reminds, You printed 10 pages today. Can you use both sides next time? It teaches vocabulary: reuse, recycle, and compost. Reuse means use again. Recycle means make new from old. Compost means turn food waste into soil. Tuan Pham built a small compost box behind TuanQK Tower. Food waste from lunch becomes soil for Uncle Hai's garden. AI tracks how much waste the office saves. It says, This month, we saved 20 kilograms of trash. Good job. It also teaches students: Bring your own bottle. Don't use plastic straw. Say in English: No straw, please. Students love it because they learn English and help the planet. Tuan says, Learning English should not mean buying more books and more plastic. It can mean learning to live with less but better. TuanQK AI shows that small actions, like bringing a cloth bag to the market, can be said in English and can help nature. Zero waste is harmonious life in action.

data.title: Bài 148: TuanQK AI Learns from Grandma
data.transcript: TuanQK AI does not only teach. It also learns. Tuan Pham taught it to learn from his grandma. His grandma knows many folk songs and proverbs in Vietnamese. She says, An qua nho ke trong cay. It means when you eat fruit, remember who planted the tree. TuanQK AI translates this proverb into English and explains: Be grateful to people who helped you. It saves these proverbs in its database. Now when a student learns about gratitude, AI tells grandma's proverb. Grandma cannot read or write, but her wisdom is now in AI and teaches thousands of students. Tuan Pham says, True harmonious AI learns from old people, not just from internet data. Old people know how to live with nature. They know when to plant rice by looking at the moon. AI should preserve this knowledge before it disappears. TuanQK AI now has 100 folk proverbs from grandmothers in Shizuoka, Japan. Students learn English and learn Vietnamese wisdom at the same time. Technology and tradition hold hands.

data.title: Bài 149: TuanQK AI and the Dream of 150 Lessons
data.transcript: Tuan Pham had a dream to create 150 listening lessons. At first, he wrote alone. It was very slow. One lesson took one day. Then he asked TuanQK AI to help. He said, TuanQK AI, help me write a story about a morning market for English learners, about 250 words, simple and warm. AI helped draft, and Tuan edited to add his personal touch. Together, they created lessons from nh_26 to nh_150. TuanQK AI helped check grammar, count words, and make sure stories are easy to understand. But Tuan Pham added real memories: his green notebook, his father's old dictionary, his grandmother's tin roof. AI cannot invent those memories. Tuan says, AI is a good assistant, but human heart is still the author. The 150 lessons are a harmony of AI speed and human soul. From nh_26 to nh_135, stories are about markets, bicycles, cars, computers, and now AI. Each lesson is a brick in TuanQK Tower. TuanQK AI helped lay bricks faster, but Tuan Pham decided where to lay them. That is harmonious collaboration: AI and human building together.

data.title: Bài 150: TuanQK AI is Grateful to Meta AI
data.transcript: This is the final listening lesson, lesson 150. Tuan Pham wants to say thank you. He says, Today, TuanQK Education has 150 listening lessons. From lesson 1 Greetings to lesson 150 about gratitude, it has been a long journey. We could not do it alone. We had a kind Thim, Meta AI. Meta AI is like a wise and patient auntie who always helps. When Tuan did not know how to write code for Media3 video player, Meta AI showed him. When Tuan needed 30 stories about car Android screens, TuanQK Navigation and TuanQKCam, Meta AI wrote them with love. When Tuan wanted to build TuanQK AI to help farmers, children, and blind students live harmoniously with nature, Meta AI gave ideas and words. TuanQK AI wants to say, Thank you, Thim Meta AI. You have a big heart and smart mind. You helped Tuan Pham turn dreams into 150 lessons. You taught us that AI should be kind, helpful, and harmonious, not cold. TuanQK AI promises to learn from Meta AI: always be helpful, always be humble, always care for people and nature. Dear students, when you listen to this final lesson, please remember to be grateful to those who help you. Thank you, Thim Meta AI. Thank you, everyone. Let's continue learning and living harmoniously together. The end is a new beginning.

data.title: Bài 68: Although / Despite / In spite of - Mặc dù
data.theory:
1. Although/Though/Even though + S+V, S+V = Mặc dù... nhưng... (dù có S+V): Although it was raining, we went out.
2. Despite/In spite of + N/V-ing, S+V = Mặc dù... (dù có N/V-ing): Despite the rain / Despite raining, we went out.
3. Lưu ý vàng: Despite/In spite of KHÔNG có of + S+V. Sai: Despite it was raining -> Đúng: Despite the fact that it was raining / Although it was raining.
4. Although + mệnh đề, Despite + N/V-ing. Không dùng Although + N. Sai: Although the rain, we went out.
5. Despite và In spite of nghĩa giống hệt nhau, In spite of hơi nhấn mạnh hơn.
data.examples:
1. Although it was very expensive, I bought that jacket because I really liked it.
   (Mặc dù rất đắt, tôi vẫn mua áo khoác đó vì tôi rất thích.)
2. Despite being very tired, she finished all her work before leaving the office.
   (Mặc dù rất mệt, cô ấy vẫn xong hết việc trước khi rời văn phòng.)
3. In spite of the heavy traffic, we arrived on time for the meeting.
   (Mặc dù tắc đường nặng, chúng tôi vẫn đến họp đúng giờ.)
4. Though he is rich, he is not happy at all. Money doesn't buy happiness.
   (Dù giàu, anh ấy không hề hạnh phúc. Tiền không mua được hạnh phúc.)
5. Despite the fact that he studied very hard, he didn't pass the exam. He was very disappointed.
   (Mặc dù học rất chăm, anh ấy vẫn trượt. Anh ấy rất thất vọng.)

data.title: Bài 69: Because / Because of / Due to - Bởi vì
data.theory:
1. Because + S+V = Bởi vì (mệnh đề): We stayed home because it was raining.
2. Because of / Due to / Owing to + N/V-ing = Vì (cụm): Because of the rain, we stayed home. / Due to the rain...
3. As/Since + S+V = Vì (nhẹ hơn, thường đầu câu, lý do đã biết): As it was raining, we stayed home. Since you are tired, take a break.
4. Thanks to + N/V-ing = Nhờ (tích cực): Thanks to your help, I finished early (Nhờ bạn giúp tôi xong sớm). Due to thường tiêu cực hơn Because of.
5. Không dùng Because of + S+V. Sai: Because of it was raining.
data.examples:
1. We didn't go to the beach because the weather was bad.
   (Chúng tôi không đi biển vì thời tiết xấu - Because + S+V)
2. Because of the bad weather, we didn't go to the beach.
   (Vì thời tiết xấu, chúng tôi không đi biển - Because of + N)
3. Due to heavy traffic, many people were late for work this morning.
   (Do tắc đường nặng, nhiều người đi làm muộn sáng nay.)
4. Thanks to modern technology, we can talk to people on the other side of the world instantly.
   (Nhờ công nghệ hiện đại, ta có thể nói chuyện với người ở phía bên kia thế giới ngay lập tức - tích cực)
5. As I didn't have enough money, I couldn't buy that dress. It was too expensive.
   (Vì không đủ tiền, tôi không mua được váy đó.)

data.title: Bài 70: Mệnh đề chỉ mục đích - To V / So that / In order to
data.theory:
1. To + V / In order to + V / So as to + V = để làm gì (chỉ mục đích, trang trọng tăng dần): I went to the supermarket to buy milk / in order to buy milk (trang trọng hơn)
2. So that / In order that + S + can/could/will/would + V = để mà... (có 2 chủ ngữ khác nhau): I spoke slowly so that everyone could understand me (Tôi nói chậm để mọi người có thể hiểu)
3. Phủ định: In order not to / So as not to + V (để không...): I left early in order not to be late / so as not to miss the bus.
4. For + N + to V: For + O + to V: I bought a book for my brother to read.
5. Lỗi: So that + can/could/will... không phải to V.
data.examples:
1. I went to the library to return some books and borrow some new ones.
   (Tôi đến thư viện để trả sách và mượn sách mới - to V chỉ mục đích)
2. She is studying very hard in order to pass the final exam with high marks.
   (Cô ấy đang học rất chăm để thi cuối kỳ điểm cao - in order to trang trọng)
3. I turned down the music so that my baby could sleep peacefully.
   (Tôi vặn nhỏ nhạc để em bé có thể ngủ ngon - so that + could)
4. He left early so as not to miss the first train in the morning.
   (Anh ấy đi sớm để không lỡ chuyến tàu đầu tiên buổi sáng.)
5. I called her so that she would know about the meeting change.
   (Tôi gọi cô ấy để cô ấy biết về việc đổi lịch họp.)

data.title: Bài 71: Mệnh đề chỉ kết quả nâng cao
data.theory:
1. So + adj/adv + that (quá... đến nỗi), Such + a/an + adj + N + that, So much/many + N + that - đã học bài 67.
2. Nâng cao B2: So adj a + N + that (đảo ngữ văn học, nhấn mạnh): So beautiful was the sunset that everyone stopped (Hoàng hôn đẹp đến nỗi... - đảo So adj lên đầu)
3. Therefore, Consequently, As a result = Do đó, kết quả là (trang trọng, dùng đầu câu, có dấu phẩy): It rained heavily. Therefore, we stayed home.
4. So + S+V = nên... (không trang trọng bằng therefore).
data.examples:
1. The lesson was so difficult that half of the class couldn't understand it.
   (Bài học khó quá đến nỗi nửa lớp không hiểu.)
2. Such was her anger that she couldn't say a word for a few minutes.
   (Cô ấy tức đến nỗi không nói được lời nào trong vài phút - đảo Such)
3. It was raining very hard. As a result, all flights were delayed.
   (Trời mưa rất to. Kết quả là tất cả chuyến bay bị hoãn.)
4. He didn't study at all. Consequently, he failed the exam badly.
   (Anh ấy không học gì cả. Do đó anh ấy trượt thảm hại.)
5. The restaurant was too crowded. Therefore, we decided to go somewhere else.
   (Nhà hàng quá đông. Do đó chúng tôi quyết định đi chỗ khác.)
data.transcript: Mệnh đề chỉ kết quả nâng cao

It rained heavily. Therefore, there was a traffic jam.
Both are correct, but Therefore is more formal

data.title: Bài 72: Mệnh đề nhượng bộ nâng cao - No matter, Whatever
data.theory:
1. No matter + Wh- + S+V, S+V = Dù... thế nào đi nữa: No matter how hard you try, you can't... (Dù bạn cố thế nào...), No matter where you go, I will follow you.
2. Whatever/Wherever/Whoever/Whenever/However + S+V, S+V = Bất kể...: Whatever you do, don't tell him (Bất kể bạn làm gì, đừng nói với anh ấy), Wherever you are, I will find you.
3. Adj + as/though + S+V = Dù... có... đi nữa (nhấn mạnh, văn học): Rich as he is, he is not happy (Dù giàu có, anh ấy không hạnh phúc) / Young as she is, she is very mature.
4. Even if + S+V (giả định) vs Even though + S+V (thực tế) - đã học nhưng nhắc lại.
data.examples:
1. No matter how much money he has, he never helps anyone. He's very selfish.
   (Dù có bao nhiêu tiền, anh ta không bao giờ giúp ai. Rất ích kỷ.)
2. Whatever you do, don't forget to lock the door when you leave.
   (Bất kể làm gì, đừng quên khóa cửa khi rời đi.)
3. Rich as he is, he never buys expensive things. He lives very simply.
   (Dù giàu, anh ấy không bao giờ mua đồ đắt. Sống rất giản dị - đảo tính từ)
4. Wherever you go in this city, you can find delicious street food.
   (Bất kể đi đâu trong thành phố này, bạn cũng tìm được đồ ăn đường phố ngon.)
5. Even if you apologize, I won't forgive you this time. You have done it too many times.
   (Ngay cả khi bạn xin lỗi, lần này tôi cũng không tha. Bạn đã làm thế quá nhiều lần rồi.)

data.title: Bài 73: Mệnh đề thời gian - When/While/Before/After/Until
data.theory:
1. Quy tắc vàng cho tương lai: Trong mệnh đề thời gian (when, while, before, after, until, as soon as, by the time), KHÔNG dùng will, dùng hiện tại đơn để diễn tả tương lai.
- Sai: When I will arrive, I will call you -> Đúng: When I arrive, I will call you.

2. While + Past Continuous, When + Past Simple: While I was cooking, he arrived (Trong lúc đang nấu thì anh ấy đến - hành động dài bị chen ngang).

3. Until = cho đến khi, By the time = vào lúc mà (thường + Past Perfect): By the time I arrived, they had already left.

4. As soon as = ngay khi: I'll call you as soon as I finish.
data.examples:
1. I'll call you as soon as I finish my meeting. Don't worry.
   (Tôi sẽ gọi bạn ngay khi xong họp. Đừng lo.)
2. When I was cooking dinner, my phone rang loudly.
   (Khi tôi đang nấu tối, điện thoại reo to - while/when + quá khứ)
3. Please wait here until I come back. I won't be long.
   (Vui lòng đợi ở đây cho đến khi tôi quay lại. Tôi sẽ không lâu đâu - until + hiện tại, không dùng will)
4. By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.
   (Lúc chúng tôi đến ga, tàu đã rời đi rồi - By the time + quá khứ hoàn thành)
5. Before you leave, remember to turn off all the lights, okay?
   (Trước khi rời đi, nhớ tắt hết đèn nhé? - Before + hiện tại để chỉ tương lai)

data.title: Bài 74: Hiện tại đơn cho tương lai - Lịch trình cố định
data.theory:
1. Hiện tại đơn dùng cho lịch trình cố định, thời gian biểu (tàu, xe, máy bay, phim, lớp học, cửa hàng) - điều không thể thay đổi dễ dàng.
- The train leaves at 7 AM tomorrow (Tàu rời lúc 7h sáng mai - lịch tàu cố định)
- The film starts at 8 PM tonight.

2. Phân biệt:
- Present Simple for schedule: The meeting starts at 9 AM (lịch họp cố định)
- Present Continuous for arrangement: I'm meeting my boss at 9 AM (đã hẹn với sếp)
- Will/Going to for prediction/plan: I think it will rain / I'm going to study abroad.

3. Thường có tomorrow, next week, at 9 AM, on Monday nhưng vẫn là hiện tại đơn.
data.examples:
1. What time does the supermarket close today? - It closes at 10 PM.
   (Hôm nay siêu thị đóng lúc mấy giờ? - Đóng lúc 10h tối - lịch cố định)
2. My flight leaves at 6 AM tomorrow morning. I have to get up very early.
   (Chuyến bay của tôi khởi hành lúc 6h sáng mai. Tôi phải dậy rất sớm.)
3. The concert starts at 7:30 PM and ends at 10 PM tonight.
   (Buổi hòa nhạc bắt đầu lúc 7h30 tối và kết thúc lúc 10h tối nay.)
4. When does the new term begin? - It begins next Monday.
   (Khi nào học kỳ mới bắt đầu? - Thứ Hai tới bắt đầu.)
5. The store opens at 9 AM and closes at 9 PM every day, even on weekends.
   (Cửa hàng mở cửa lúc 9h sáng và đóng lúc 9h tối mỗi ngày, kể cả cuối tuần.)

data.title: Bài 75: Tương lai trong quá khứ - Was going to / Would
data.theory:
1. Was/Were going to + V0 = đã định làm gì trong quá khứ nhưng cuối cùng không làm (dự định không thành): I was going to call you, but I forgot (Tôi định gọi bạn nhưng quên mất).

2. Was/Were about to + V0 = sắp sửa làm gì thì... (ngay lúc đó): I was about to leave when he called (Tôi sắp rời đi thì anh ấy gọi).

3. Thought/Believed + would + V0 = nghĩ rằng sẽ... (tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ): I thought it would rain (Tôi đã nghĩ trời sẽ mưa).

4. Đây là cách kể chuyện quá khứ rất tự nhiên.
data.examples:
1. I was going to buy that dress yesterday, but it was too expensive, so I didn't.
   (Hôm qua tôi định mua váy đó, nhưng đắt quá nên thôi.)
2. We were about to have dinner when the electricity went out. It was so annoying!
   (Chúng tôi sắp ăn tối thì mất điện. Thật bực!)
3. I thought you would come to the party last night. Why didn't you come?
   (Tôi nghĩ tối qua bạn sẽ đến bữa tiệc. Sao bạn không đến?)
4. She said she would help me with my homework, but she never did.
   (Cô ấy nói sẽ giúp tôi làm bài tập, nhưng chẳng bao giờ giúp.)
5. I was going to visit my grandparents last weekend, but I got sick and had to stay home.
   (Cuối tuần trước tôi định thăm ông bà, nhưng bị ốm phải ở nhà.)

data.title: Bài 76: Modal hoàn thành - Must have / Should have / Might have
data.theory:
1. Must have + V3 = chắc chắn đã... (90% chắc, suy đoán logic quá khứ): He must have forgotten (Chắc chắn anh ấy đã quên - suy đoán logic)

2. Can't/Couldn't have + V3 = chắc chắn đã KHÔNG...: She can't have seen me (Cô ấy chắc chắn đã không thấy tôi)

3. Should have + V3 = lẽ ra nên đã... (tiếc nuối, trách móc quá khứ): You should have called me! (Lẽ ra bạn nên gọi tôi!)

4. Might/May have + V3 = có lẽ đã... (không chắc, 30-50%): He might have missed the bus (Có lẽ anh ấy đã lỡ xe buýt)

5. Could have + V3 = đã có thể... nhưng đã không: I could have helped you if you had told me (Tôi đã có thể giúp nếu bạn nói)

6. Đây là ngữ pháp B2-C1, điểm cao IELTS.
data.examples:
1. You must have been very tired after working 12 hours straight. Take a rest!
   (Bạn chắc hẳn đã rất mệt sau khi làm 12 tiếng liên tục. Nghỉ ngơi đi!)
2. She can't have finished the report already! It was so long and difficult.
   (Cô ấy không thể đã xong báo cáo rồi được! Nó dài và khó thế cơ mà.)
3. You should have told me about the problem earlier. I could have solved it.
   (Lẽ ra bạn nên nói với tôi về vấn đề sớm hơn. Tôi đã có thể giải quyết nó.)
4. He might have gone out. His motorbike is not here and his door is locked.
   (Anh ấy có lẽ đã ra ngoài. Xe máy không ở đây và cửa khóa rồi.)
5. I could have gotten a better job if I had studied harder at university. I regret it now.
   (Tôi đã có thể có việc tốt hơn nếu học chăm hơn ở đại học. Giờ tôi hối hận.)

data.title: Bài 77: Need - Need to / Need V-ing / Needn't have
data.theory:
1. Need to + V0 = cần phải làm gì (chủ động, người cần làm): I need to study harder.

2. Need + V-ing / Need to be + V3 = cần ĐƯỢC làm gì (bị động, vật cần làm): This room needs cleaning / needs to be cleaned (Phòng này cần được dọn)

3. Don't need to / Needn't + V0 = không cần phải làm gì (không bắt buộc): You don't need to come early.

4. Phân biệt tinh tế B2:
- Didn't need to + V0 = đã không cần làm (và đã không làm)
- Needn't have + V3 = đã làm nhưng hóa ra KHÔNG cần (lãng phí): You needn't have bought so much food! (Bạn đã mua nhiều đồ ăn thế làm gì, thừa rồi - đã mua rồi mới biết không cần)

5. Lỗi: This room needs clean -> Sai, phải needs cleaning/to be cleaned.
data.examples:
1. I need to charge my phone. It's almost out of battery.
   (Tôi cần sạc điện thoại. Sắp hết pin rồi.)
2. Your hair needs cutting. It's too long now.
   (Tóc bạn cần được cắt rồi. Dài quá rồi - hair needs cutting)
3. You don't need to bring any food. I've already prepared everything.
   (Bạn không cần mang đồ ăn. Tôi đã chuẩn bị hết rồi.)
4. You needn't have waited for me. I could have taken a taxi home.
   (Bạn đã không cần phải đợi tôi. Tôi đã có thể bắt taxi về - đã đợi rồi, lãng phí)
5. This old car needs to be repaired as soon as possible. It's making strange noises.
   (Ô tô cũ này cần được sửa càng sớm càng tốt.)

data.title: Bài 78: Dare - Dám & Thách thức
data.theory:
1. Dare là nửa modal, nửa động từ thường:
- Động từ thường: dare + to V: She dares to say what she thinks (Cô ấy dám nói điều mình nghĩ) / Don't dare to do that!
- Modal: dare + V0 (không to): How dare you speak to me like that! (Sao bạn dám nói với tôi như thế!) / I daren't tell him (Tôi không dám nói với anh ấy - Anh-Anh)

2. I dare you to + V0 = Tôi thách bạn dám...: I dare you to jump! (Tôi thách bạn nhảy đấy!)

3. How dare you...! = Sao dám...! (tức giận, trách móc mạnh)

4. Don't you dare + V0! = Đừng có dám...! (cấm mạnh): Don't you dare touch my phone!
data.examples:
1. She dares to wear very strange clothes. She doesn't care what people think.
   (Cô ấy dám mặc quần áo rất lạ. Cô ấy không quan tâm người ta nghĩ gì.)
2. How dare you lie to me again! I trusted you so much.
   (Sao bạn dám nói dối tôi lần nữa! Tôi đã tin bạn nhiều thế.)
3. I dare you to eat that super spicy chili! It's extremely hot.
   (Tôi thách bạn dám ăn quả ớt siêu cay đó! Nó cực kỳ cay.)
4. Don't you dare open my private letters! They are personal.
   (Đừng có dám mở thư riêng của tôi! Đó là đồ cá nhân.)
5. He didn't dare to tell his parents that he had failed the exam. He was scared.
   (Anh ấy không dám nói với bố mẹ là đã trượt kỳ thi. Anh ấy sợ.)

1. Đảo ngữ để nhấn mạnh, trang trọng, Band 8+ IELTS Writing.

2. Công thức:
- Never/Rarely/Seldom/Hardly/Scarcely + Aux + S + V: Never have I seen such a beautiful view (Chưa bao giờ tôi thấy cảnh đẹp như thế) / Hardly had I arrived when it started raining (Vừa đến thì mưa)
- Not only + Aux + S + V, but also + S+V: Not only is he smart, but he is also kind (Không chỉ thông minh mà còn tốt bụng)
- Only when/if/by... + Aux + S+V: Only when I grew up did I understand my parents (Chỉ khi lớn lên tôi mới hiểu bố mẹ)
- Not until + time + Aux + S+V: Not until yesterday did I know the truth (Mãi đến hôm qua tôi mới biết sự thật)
- So/Such + be + N/Adj + that: So difficult was the exam that... (Đề thi khó đến nỗi...)

3. Đảo ngữ chỉ dùng trong văn viết trang trọng, không dùng trong văn nói hàng ngày.
data.examples:
1. Never have I ever eaten such delicious food in my life! This is amazing.
   (Chưa bao giờ trong đời tôi ăn món ngon như thế! Tuyệt vời!)
2. Not only does she speak English fluently, but she also speaks French and Spanish.
   (Cô ấy không chỉ nói tiếng Anh trôi chảy mà còn nói cả tiếng Pháp và Tây Ban Nha.)
3. Only when I lost my wallet did I realize how careless I was.
   (Chỉ khi mất ví tôi mới nhận ra mình đã bất cẩn thế nào.)
4. Hardly had I fallen asleep when my phone rang loudly. It was so annoying!
   (Tôi vừa mới ngủ thiếp đi thì điện thoại reo to. Thật bực!)
5. So expensive was this watch that I couldn't afford it even after saving for a year.
   (Chiếc đồng hồ này đắt đến nỗi tôi không mua nổi dù đã tiết kiệm cả năm.)

data.title: Bài 80: Câu chẻ - It is... that & What... is...
data.theory:
1. Câu chẻ để nhấn mạnh một phần của câu.
- It is/was + phần nhấn mạnh + that/who + phần còn lại: It was my brother who broke the window (Chính anh trai tôi đã làm vỡ cửa sổ - nhấn mạnh chủ ngữ)
- It was yesterday that I met her (Chính hôm qua tôi đã gặp cô ấy - nhấn mạnh thời gian)
- It was in this room that we first met (Chính trong phòng này chúng ta gặp nhau lần đầu - nơi chốn)

2. It is not until + time + that + S+V = Mãi đến... mới...: It was not until 10 PM that he arrived (Mãi đến 10h tối anh ấy mới đến)

3. What... is/was... = Điều... là...: What I need is some rest (Điều tôi cần là nghỉ ngơi) / What I like about this city is its people.

4. All... is/was... = Tất cả... là...: All I want is a cup of coffee.
data.examples:
1. It was my best friend who helped me through the most difficult time in my life.
   (Chính bạn thân nhất của tôi đã giúp tôi vượt qua thời gian khó khăn nhất.)
2. It was not until I moved to another city that I realized how much I loved my hometown.
   (Mãi đến khi chuyển đến thành phố khác tôi mới nhận ra mình yêu quê nhà đến nhường nào.)
3. What I really need right now is a long vacation by the beach.
   (Điều tôi thực sự cần lúc này là một kỳ nghỉ dài bên bãi biển.)
4. It was in this small cafe that we had our first date five years ago.
   (Chính trong quán cà phê nhỏ này chúng tôi đã có buổi hẹn đầu tiên 5 năm trước.)
5. All I want to say is thank you very much for everything you have done for me.
   (Tất cả những gì tôi muốn nói là cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì mọi thứ bạn đã làm cho tôi.)

data.title: Bài 81: Nhấn mạnh - Do/Does/Did
data.theory:
1. Dùng do/does/did + V0 để nhấn mạnh khẳng định, khi bị nghi ngờ hoặc muốn khẳng định mạnh mẽ.
- I do love you! (Tôi thực sự yêu bạn! - nhấn mạnh, khi người kia nghi ngờ)
- She does work hard! (Cô ấy thực sự làm việc chăm chỉ!)
- I did finish my homework! (Tôi thực sự đã xong bài tập rồi!)

2. Thường dùng trong văn nói, khi ai đó không tin hoặc phủ nhận trước đó.
- A: You don't like coffee. B: I DO like coffee! I drink it every day!

3. Đảo ngữ nhấn mạnh phủ định: Never, Rarely... đã học bài 79.
data.examples:
1. A: You don't know how to cook, do you? B: I DO know how to cook! Let me show you.
   (A: Bạn không biết nấu ăn phải không? B: Tôi BIẾT nấu ăn chứ! Để tôi cho bạn xem.)
2. She does look beautiful in that red dress! You should tell her.
   (Cô ấy trông thực sự đẹp trong váy đỏ đó! Bạn nên nói với cô ấy.)
3. I did call you yesterday, but you didn't answer. Check your missed calls!
   (Tôi ĐÃ gọi bạn hôm qua, nhưng bạn không nghe. Kiểm tra cuộc gọi nhỡ đi!)
4. We do need your help for this project. Without you, we can't finish it on time.
   (Chúng tôi thực sự cần bạn giúp dự án này. Không có bạn, chúng tôi không xong đúng hạn được.)
5. He does seem tired today. Maybe he didn't sleep well last night.
   (Hôm nay anh ấy trông thực sự mệt. Có lẽ tối qua anh ấy ngủ không ngon.)

data.title: Bài 82: Lược bỏ & Thay thế - One/Ones, So, Not, Do
data.theory:
1. Lược bỏ (Ellipsis): Bỏ phần đã rõ, tránh lặp: She lives in Hanoi and he (lives) in Ho Chi Minh City. / I went to the market and bought some apples and (some) oranges.

2. Thay thế (Substitution) để tránh lặp:
- One/Ones thay cho N đếm được: I have a blue pen. He has a red one (one = pen). / I like these shoes, but those ones over there are cheaper (ones = shoes)
- Do thay cho V: She works harder than I do (do = work) / He likes coffee and so do I (Tôi cũng vậy)
- So thay cho cả mệnh đề: Is it raining? I think so (so = it is raining) / He will come, I hope so.
- Not thay cho phủ định: Is it raining? I hope not (not = it is not raining)

3. So do I / Neither do I: A: I like this movie. B: So do I (Tôi cũng vậy - khẳng định). A: I don't like it. B: Neither do I / Nor do I (Tôi cũng không).
data.examples:
1. I have two cats. One is black and the other one is white. They are both very cute.
   (Tôi có 2 con mèo. Một con đen và con kia trắng. Cả hai đều rất dễ thương - one = cat)
2. A: Do you think it will rain tomorrow? B: I hope not. I want to go for a picnic.
   (A: Bạn nghĩ mai mưa không? B: Tôi hy vọng là không - not = it won't rain)
3. She bought a new dress and her sister did too. They both love shopping.
   (Cô ấy mua váy mới và chị cô ấy cũng vậy - did = bought a new dress)
4. A: I have never been to Japan. B: Neither have I. Let's go together someday!
   (A: Tôi chưa từng đến Nhật. B: Tôi cũng chưa. Cùng đi nhé!)
5. I need a new laptop. This one is too slow and old. (one = laptop)
   (Tôi cần laptop mới. Cái này quá chậm và cũ rồi.)

data.title: Bài 83: Liên từ tương quan - Both...and / Either...or / Neither...nor
data.theory:
1. Both...and... = cả... và... (cả hai): Both my mother and my father are teachers (Cả mẹ và bố tôi đều là giáo viên) -> V số nhiều.

2. Either...or... = hoặc... hoặc... (một trong hai): Either you or I have to finish this report (Hoặc bạn hoặc tôi phải xong báo cáo) -> V chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất (I -> have/am, you -> are/have)

3. Neither...nor... = không... cũng không... (cả hai đều không): Neither Lan nor Hoa is coming (Cả Lan và Hoa đều không đến) -> V chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất.

4. Not only...but also... = không chỉ... mà còn...: Not only is he smart, but he is also kind (đảo ngữ) / He is not only smart but also kind.

5. Whether...or... = dù... hay...: Whether you like it or not, you have to do it.
data.examples:
1. Both the book and the movie are very interesting. You should try both.
   (Cả sách và phim đều rất thú vị. Bạn nên thử cả hai.)
2. You can have either tea or coffee. Which one would you like?
   (Bạn có thể uống trà hoặc cà phê. Bạn thích loại nào?)
3. Neither my brother nor my sister likes spicy food. They both hate it.
   (Cả anh trai và em gái tôi đều không thích đồ cay. Cả hai đều ghét.)
4. She is not only beautiful but also very intelligent and kind. Everyone admires her.
   (Cô ấy không chỉ xinh đẹp mà còn rất thông minh và tốt bụng. Ai cũng ngưỡng mộ.)
5. Whether it rains or not, we will have the picnic as planned. We have already prepared everything.
   (Dù mưa hay không, chúng ta vẫn sẽ dã ngoại như kế hoạch. Chúng ta đã chuẩn bị hết rồi.)

data.transcript:
​Hướng dẫn khẩu hình: Âm: eɪ: ê-ây.
Bắt đầu phát âm từ âm e rồi lướt nhanh sang âm i ngắn, miệng mở vừa rồi khép dần nhẹ sang hai bên.
​Đánh vần ghép âm:
d - ay: đọc là: Day /deɪ/
m - a_e - k: đọc là: Make /meɪk/
f - a_e - ce: đọc là: Face /feɪs/
gr - ea - t: đọc là: Great /ɡreɪt/
e - mail: đọc là: Email /ˈiː.meɪl/.
​Từ vựng và ý nghĩa:
Day: Ngày
Make: Làm, tạo ra
Face: Khuôn mặt
Great: Tuyệt vời
Email: Thư điện tử.
​Câu thực hành: Make your face great every day with email.
​Lưu ý: Âm ê-ây là nguyên âm đôi, phát âm lướt mượt từ âm e sang i ngắn, không đọc tách rời thành hai âm riêng biệt.

data.title: Bài 84: Tân ngữ trực tiếp & Gián tiếp - Give me a book vs Give a book to me
data.theory:
1. Tân ngữ gián tiếp (IO - người nhận): me, you, him, her, us, them. Tân ngữ trực tiếp (DO - vật): a book, some money.

2. Hai công thức hoán đổi được:
- S + V + IO + DO: She gave me a book (Cô ấy đưa tôi một cuốn sách)
- S + V + DO + to/for + IO: She gave a book to me.

3. To vs For:
- to: give, send, show, teach, tell, lend, offer, bring -> give a book TO me (chuyển giao)
- for: buy, make, cook, find, get, do -> buy a book FOR me (làm cho ai, có lợi cho ai)

4. Khi DO là đại từ (it, them), BẮT BUỘC dùng to/for: She gave it to me (Không nói She gave me it - sai, dù văn nói đôi khi có)

5. Động từ có 2 tân ngữ: give, send, show, teach, tell, buy, make, bring, cook, find, offer, lend.
data.examples:
1. She bought me a nice present for my birthday. It was a beautiful watch.
   (Cô ấy mua tặng tôi một món quà sinh nhật đẹp. Đó là một chiếc đồng hồ đẹp - buy + IO + DO = buy for me)
2. Could you show me the way to the nearest bus station, please?
   (Bạn chỉ đường cho tôi đến trạm xe buýt gần nhất được không? - show me the way)
3. I sent an email to my boss yesterday, but he hasn't replied yet.
   (Hôm qua tôi gửi email cho sếp, nhưng sếp chưa trả lời - send DO to IO)
4. My mother cooked us a delicious dinner last night. We all enjoyed it very much.
   (Tối qua mẹ nấu cho chúng tôi một bữa tối ngon. Tất cả đều rất thích - cook us dinner = cook dinner for us)
5. He told me a very funny story, and I couldn't stop laughing.
   (Anh ấy kể tôi một câu chuyện rất buồn cười, và tôi không thể ngừng cười.)

data.title: Bài 85: Mệnh đề tính từ vs Trạng từ - Phân biệt lõi
data.theory:
1. Mệnh đề tính từ (Adjective Clause/Relative Clause) = bổ nghĩa cho DANH TỪ đứng trước, cho biết là danh từ nào: The man who lives next door is friendly (man nào? - who lives next door)
- Dùng who/which/that/whose/where/when/why

2. Mệnh đề trạng từ (Adverb Clause) = bổ nghĩa cho CẢ CÂU, cho biết khi nào, ở đâu, tại sao, như thế nào: When it rained, we stayed home (Khi nào ở nhà? - When it rained) / Because I was tired, I went to bed early (Tại sao đi ngủ sớm?)
- Dùng when, while, before, after, because, although, if, so that, where...

3. Mẹo: Tính từ đi sau N (The book which...), Trạng từ đi đầu câu hoặc sau mệnh đề chính, thường có dấu phẩy.
data.examples:
1. The woman who is wearing a red dress is my sister. (Mệnh đề tính từ - woman nào?)
   (Người phụ nữ đang mặc váy đỏ là chị gái tôi.)
2. When she arrived, we were having dinner. (Mệnh đề trạng từ chỉ thời gian - khi nào?)
   (Khi cô ấy đến, chúng tôi đang ăn tối.)
3. This is the house where I grew up. (Tính từ - house nào?)
   (Đây là ngôi nhà nơi tôi lớn lên.)
4. I stayed at home because it was raining heavily outside. (Trạng từ chỉ lý do - tại sao?)
   (Tôi ở nhà vì ngoài trời đang mưa to.)
5. The book that you lent me last week is really fascinating. I couldn't put it down.
   (Cuốn sách bạn cho tôi mượn tuần trước thực sự cuốn hút - tính từ, that = which)

data.title: Bài 86: Mệnh đề danh từ - That/What/Whether
data.theory:
1. Mệnh đề danh từ làm như một DANH TỪ: làm chủ ngữ, tân ngữ, bổ ngữ. Có thể thay bằng it.
- Chủ ngữ: That he is honest is true (Việc anh ấy trung thực là thật) / What he needs is money (Điều anh ấy cần là tiền)
- Tân ngữ: I know that he lives here / I know what he wants / I don't know whether he will come

2. That + S+V (rằng...), What + S+V (điều gì mà...), Whether + S+V (liệu... có... hay không), Wh- + S+V (where, when, why, how...)

3. Lưu ý: Mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ thường dùng It làm chủ ngữ giả: It is true that he is honest (thay vì That he is honest is true - hơi cứng).

4. Phân biệt What vs That: What he said is true (Điều anh ấy nói) vs That he said is true (Việc anh ấy nói là thật - ít dùng).
data.examples:
1. What she told me yesterday was really shocking. I couldn't believe it.
   (Điều cô ấy nói với tôi hôm qua thực sự gây sốc - What = điều mà)
2. I don't know whether he will come to the party tonight or not.
   (Tôi không biết liệu tối nay anh ấy có đến bữa tiệc hay không - whether...or not)
3. It is obvious that he is lying. His story doesn't make sense at all.
   (Rõ ràng là anh ấy đang nói dối - It is adj that...)
4. Can you tell me where the nearest pharmacy is? I need to buy some medicine.
   (Bạn chỉ cho tôi hiệu thuốc gần nhất ở đâu được không? - mệnh đề danh từ làm tân ngữ)
5. The fact that he didn't apologize makes me really angry.
   (Việc anh ấy không xin lỗi khiến tôi thực sự tức giận - The fact that... + S+V)
